Inflation Developments
1. In February, consumer prices were up by 0.30 percent and annual inflation decreased to 7.03 percent, which is attributed to food prices.
Moreover, the deceleration in the monthly rate of increase in processed food prices got more pronounced in this period.

Although bread and cereals group maintained rising prices in line with the domestic wheat prices outlook, annual processed food inflation went down by 0.5 percentage points to 8.39 percent owing to the favorable course of other processed food products in February.
Meanwhile, core inflation indicators and prices of services remained on a mild track.
